owner: the Top Beauty Med Spa team
summary: A Midtown Toronto med spa appears to lose bookings to leftover template text, a free builder address and no WhatsApp.

findings.problem: One service appears to still carry template text, Describe your service here. What makes it great? Use short catchy text to tell people what you offer.
findings.cost: Template text on a booking page makes the business look unfinished and costs trust.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner on the page.
findings.cost: A free builder address looks temporary for a med spa that charges for treatments.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a business email.

findings.problem: The contact appears to be a gmail address, with a contact form and a phone number but no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Clients who want to book at night message first, and a free email gives less trust.
findings.fix: A business email and a one tap WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: The page appears to list teeth whitening and waxing next to a med spa label, with no prices or before and after proof.
findings.cost: Clients comparing med spas look for clear treatments, prices and results.
findings.fix: Treatment pages with prices and results.
